candidate.answerReason: For arc length \(l\) and radius \(r>0\), the radian measure is \(l/r\). When \(l=r\), this ratio equals 1.

methods.label: Apply the radian definition
methods.explanation: The radian measure equals the arc length divided by the radius. When the two are equal, the central angle is 1 radian.
methods.levelReason: Applies the definition of radian measure and the elementary meaning of a ratio.
